|errata_history=Four source-verified Modern designs are documented in source order. This is Errata 3 in that documented sequence. The supported current full face is [[Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2) (Errata 3)]] (<code>202_2</code>). Archive captures establish known-by bounds; neither PDF build metadata nor repository-copy times establish a first-publication day. No additional state is assigned to the pixel-identical2017 copy.
* '''Original''' ([[Palace Raider (Virtual Set 2)]]): known by 10 October 2015. Actual source: [[:File:PC-Set2-PalaceRaider-2015-10-10-slip.png]]. Printed mark: no errata mark. Bottom caption: “Palace Raider”. Game text (pilot shorthand transcribed): “[Pilot] 2. Palace Raiders (including this character) are deploy -3 if You’re A Slave? on table. While driving a vehicle, it is power +3, defense value +1, and moves for free.”<ref name="palace-set2-2015">Players Committee, [[:File:Virtual-Set-2-October-2015-capture.pdf|Virtual Set 2 sheet, archived 10 October 2015]], page 2. Original capture: [https://web.archive.org/web/20151010191753/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/virtual/Set-2.pdf Internet Archive]. The timestamp proves availability by that date, not initial publication.</ref>

* This card deploys -3 if [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?{{!}}You're A Slave?]] on table. Then, while active on table, it causes other Palace Raiders to deploy -3.
* The deploy -3 text is not cumulative (not even if one is on table and one is in hand - the result will be deploy -3, not deploy -6).
